title: Length of the emission mask
statement: For every finite deterministic Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, every input word $x$, every configuration $d$ of $M$ on $x$, and every $t \in \mathbb{N}$, the emission mask of the first $t$ steps from $d$ has length exactly $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every deterministic machine $M$, configuration $d$ and step count $t$, the emission mask of the run of $M$ from $d$ over $t$ steps has length exactly $t$.
